bio: Tang Miu is an independent indie pop artist and musician who began his music journey in 2017. He writes, records and produces his own music, turning personal experiences and small everyday feelings into songs. Each release is part of an ongoing diary — a record of where he was, what he felt, and what he is still becoming.
shortBio: Independent artist and musician creating intimate indie pop from feelings, memories and everyday stories.
